note: Both sets cover essentially the same page content — the W/HSS/L/C/PL section designations, the 9'-0" T.O. steel to grade elevation, the 11'-4" and 18'-0" datums, and the assorted dimensions — with matching quotes. The only real differences are that A tags W10X12 and HSS4X6X1/4 with a "conditions: S-301" entry (S-301 is a detail/sheet reference, not a condition, and the page does not bind it to those members), while B instead repeats the PL3"X1/4" and HSS4X4X1/4" facts an extra time. B therefore contains fewer unsupported claims, but both sets duplicate the 9'-0" elevation and the plate/HSS sections and both truncate the HSS4X4X1/4 value to "4X4X1/4".
remarks: Both extractions leave out C8X11.5 (a member section shown on the page) and most of the framing dimensions (27'-8", 32'-0", 8'-8 5/8", 8'-8 1/2", 2'-2 5/8", 7'-6", 5'-6", 4'-0", 5'-0", 2'-0"). Both also state the same plate fact twice (PL3"X1/4" as section and as 3"X1/4" dimensions) and the same 9'-0" T.O. steel elevation twice under two entity names. Generic entities like "dimension", "structure" and "elevation" give no component binding for the dimension claims; the 2'-4", 3", 8", 12'-0", 10'-0", 3'-1" and 7 7/8" values are unbound to any member or location. The S-301/A1/C4 strings are section or detail callouts, not conditions — a recurring misbinding pattern worth fixing in the extractor.
